items.fact: The campaign has five chapters, and the chapters unlock in order once you finish every mission in the one before.
Sources disagree on the exact mission count. PC Gamer lists 91 story missions across the five chapters. Insider Gaming says there are 93.
The five chapters are titled Just Like Paradise, Paradise Lost, Tits Ass Drug Money, Vice City Baby, and Top of the World Ma.
Missions cannot be replayed once you have completed them.
The two protagonists are Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, a criminal duo caught up in a conspiracy across Leonida.

The game is set in the state of Leonida, with Vice City as its biggest city. Regions include the Leonida Keys, the Grassrivers wetlands, the industrial town of Ambrosia, and Mount Kalaga National Park.
Collectible cards are spread across Leonida's five counties.
There are 18 collectible card sets. Each set contains between 12 and 36 cards, and you can sell cards at pawn shops.
The WAiNK phone app scans 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures. Scanning 100 scannable locations earns the You WAiNKer trophy.

The 100% completion checklist requires 15 card sets, 33 underwater discoveries, 30 magazines, books and comics, 15 meditation spots and 100 cocaine flamingos. You do not need every collectible to reach 100%.
There are 80 challenges in eight categories of ten each. Insider Gaming says 70 of them are needed for 100% completion.
Activities include 40 unique race locations, pool at bars, scuba treasure dives for Kenton, and demolition derbies at Ambrosia Raceway.
From Chapter 2 you can steal cars for Moses. From Chapter 3 you can sell higher-end cars to Randy, whose wish list has 18 sports cars paying $30,000 or more.
Bank vaults unlock near the end of Chapter 4 and can pay up to $200,000, but they trigger an instant 4-star wanted level.
Rival gang hideouts show their security level and score value on the map. They respawn and can pay $10,000 to $30,000 per run late in the game.
Check the map for back doors before a robbery, because the snap gun lets you enter without setting off alarms. Rob medium- and high-security places as a pair.
Hold off on banks and loan stores until Chapter 3, when you get a dye pack jammer. Without one, the cash explodes when you move away from the building.
The Scooter Bros app summons and repairs your vehicles and can free them from impound. Premium costs $12,500 and gives three free uses per day. Gas pumps offer cheaper repairs.
RydeMe offers fast travel for $100 once you are in the car. Buses and trains are a cheaper option but run on schedules.
A 602MB day-one patch, version 01.002.001, was released. PS5 players also needed a mandatory system software update.
The game has no dedicated first-person mode. A glitch found hours after launch enables it, and you have to reload your save to get back to third person.
A Chapter 1 stash-bag duplication glitch involving Brian's Lockup in Key Lento reportedly pays about $8,000 every five minutes. Game Rant calls it unpatched for now.
